Since July 25, 2018, it had 0 insider purchases, and 5 sales for $580,904 activity. Rodgers Steven Ralph sold 2,213 shares worth $116,028. Shares for $66,324 were sold by Shenoy Navin. Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) Receives a Downgrade
The stock rating of Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) was downgraded by professional analysts at DZ Bank from a the old “Buy” rating to a more updated “Hold” in an analyst report sent to investors and clients on Thursday morning. The brokerage firm now has a $50 target on shares, suggesting a possible upside of 4.82 %. Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC) Ratings Coverage
Among 24 analysts covering Intel ( NASDAQ:INTC ), 8 have Buy rating, 5 Sell and 11 Hold. Therefore 33% are positive. Intel has $6500 highest and $42 lowest target. $54.31’s average target is 13.86% above currents $47.7 stock price. Intel had 36 analyst reports since May 30, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was downgraded by Northland Capital on Monday, June 18 to “Underperform”. The stock of Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC) earned “Outperform” rating by BMO Capital Markets on Friday, October 26. Citigroup downgraded the stock to “Neutral” rating in Friday, July 27 report. Raymond James downgraded the stock to “Underperform” rating in Tuesday, September 25 report. The rating was maintained by KeyBanc Capital Markets on Friday, July 27 with “Overweight”. As per Monday, August 6, the company rating was downgraded by Barclays Capital. On Tuesday, July 31 the stock rating was upgraded by DZ Bank to “Buy”. Bank of America downgraded it to “Neutral” rating and $56 target in Friday, July 27 report. The stock has “Hold” rating by Nomura on Monday, June 25. The stock of Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC) earned “Underweight” rating by Barclays Capital on Monday, October 1.
The stock decreased 2.37% or $1.16 during the last trading session, reaching $47.7. About 23.59M shares traded. Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC) has risen 24.49% since November 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 8.87% the S&P500.
Intel Corporation designs, manufactures, and sells computer, networking, and communications platforms worldwide. The company has market cap of $217.70 billion. The firm operates through Client Computing Group, Data Center Group, Internet of Things Group, Non-Volatile Memory Solutions Group, Intel Security Group, Programmable Solutions Group, and All Other divisions. It has a 14.91 P/E ratio. The Company’s platforms are used in notebooks, 2 in 1 systems, desktops, servers, tablets, smartphones, wireless and wired connectivity products, and mobile communication components; enterprise, cloud, and communication infrastructure; and retail, transportation, industrial, video, buildings, and other market divisions.
